acceptanceCriteria: The orchestrator's heartbeat procedure checks each running lane's last tool activity and flags lanes idle for more than 30 min.
A flagged lane is messaged once, then stopped or redispatched, with its claim released and the reason retained.
A replay over this session's transcripts would have flagged the 16.6 h docs lane within 1 h.
body: Evidence: owner-requested audit on 2026-10-17 of orchestrator session 03e2afac (Handoff 2026-10-14): 206 Claude Code lane subagents, 374 lane-hours over 77 h wall. Measured from subagent transcripts under ~/.claude/projects/-Users-russelllewis-projects-corvint/03e2afac-.../subagents (tool_use to tool_result timestamps) and live host reads. Toolchain: corvint-tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.615, Go 1.27.2, macOS 12-core/64 GB host. "Docs batch lane 1395/1396/1342" (Sonnet, effort-medium) spanned 16.6 h wall with 46 Bash calls totalling 0.2 h; it sat parked waiting for a reply or notification that never came. The orchestrator's heartbeat pass renews leases but does not check lane tool activity. Expected: a lane with no tool activity for more than 30 min is detected, nudged once, then stopped or redispatched, and its Tasks claim released.
